Every tier includes these templates

  • Homepage
  • Collection (PLP)
  • Product (PDP)
  • Cart and cart drawer
  • Search and results
  • Component library
  • 3–4 more page templates chosen with you: Our Story, landing pages, bundle or quiz, account

And this coverage

  • Mobile, tablet and desktop for every template
  • ADA / WCAG 2.1 AA designed in from day one
  • Every interaction state: hover, focus, error, empty, loading, sold out
  • Motion design
  • Photography and video direction
  • Directional copy
  • Sections your team edits in Shopify’s theme editor
  • Handoff to engineers on the same team

Timelines run from kickoff with approved brand guidelines to launch-ready design. Shopify licensing, apps, and photo and video production are separate.
